next.reason: 1985: 'control is transferred to the end of the UNSTRING statement or, if the ON OVERFLOW phrase is specified, to imperative-statement-1'; 2023: 'b) The EC-OVERFLOW-UNSTRING exception condition is set to exist. ... d) If the ON OVERFLOW phrase is not specified, execution continues as specified in 14.6.13.1.4'. 2023 adds setting EC-OVERFLOW-UNSTRING. Without ON OVERFLOW, flow follows the nonfatal exception rules, so a declarative may run instead of control going straight to the end.
